tasks.subject: [mcp-server-management] [P1] Managed MCP server schema on AgentManifest + marketplace guard
tasks.description: Add ManagedMcpServerSchema + McpServerTransportSchema (stdio/http/sse discriminated union) and the mcpServers array field to AgentManifestSchema in packages/shared/src/mesh-schemas.ts (after enabledToolGroups, default []). Do NOT add it to AgentManifestUpdateSchema. Do NOT apply .catch() (a bad entry must fail loudly). Reuse the McpAppServerConnection union shape so toSdkMcpServerConfig converts it. Set enabled default false (safe-defaults). Reject mcpServers in packaged manifests in the marketplace validator (packages/marketplace). Tests: schema valid/invalid, manifest writeManifest->readManifest round-trip preserves mcpServers, marketplace validator rejects a packaged manifest declaring mcpServers.
tasks.acceptance: Schema + type exported; agent-creator defaults mcpServers: []; marketplace validator rejects the field; unit tests green.

tasks.subject: [mcp-server-management] [P1] AgentMcpServerService (CRUD + injectable + fingerprint + test)
tasks.description: New runtime-neutral service (apps/server/src/services/mesh/agent-mcp-server-service.ts): CRUD over AgentManifest.mcpServers via readManifest/writeManifest keyed by agent id (resolve agent -> workspace path via AgentRegistry). injectableServersForCwd(cwd): read manifest at cwd, return Record<string,McpAppServerConnection> of enabled entries only, [] for a manifest-less cwd, cached by manifest mtime. add/update reject reserved name 'dorkos' and duplicate names. test(agentId,name): transiently connect/spawn the stored server and report ok/toolCount/error. Tests over a real temp dir (not a mock): CRUD writes through to file; injectable returns only enabled; disable removes from injection; reserved/duplicate rejected.
tasks.acceptance: Service methods implemented + unit-tested against a real temp manifest; injectableServersForCwd correct.

tasks.subject: [mcp-server-management] [P2] mcp.* capability domain + registry wiring + HTTP surfaces
tasks.description: New domain apps/server/src/services/mesh/mcp-capabilities.ts following connector-capabilities.ts: module-augment CapabilityDeps with mcpDeps; requireMcpDeps helper; mcpDomain (name 'mcp') with verbs list(observe)/add(destructive)/update(destructive)/remove(act)/enable(act)/disable(act)/test(act). add/update carry approvalDisplayFields for connection.transport/command/args/url. surfaces.http per spec table (GET/POST/PATCH/DELETE /api/agents/:agentId/mcp-servers[...]). Register gated in composeDorkOsCapabilityRegistry and unconditionally in composeCapabilityRegistryForDocs (dorkos-registry.ts). Wire mcpDeps at startup (index.ts). Tests: mcp.add returns ApprovalRequiredPayload without approval and writes the entry after approval (prove the gate can fail); mcp.list is observe/free; approval card carries the command fields.
tasks.acceptance: dorkos call mcp.* works; tier gate enforced; HTTP routes projected; tests green including the negative approval path.

tasks.subject: [mcp-server-management] [P2] Inject managed servers into the claude-code session factory
tasks.description: In apps/server/src/index.ts setMcpServerFactory closure, add a spread of ...toSdkMcpServers(agentMcpService.injectableServersForCwd(session.cwd)) BEFORE connectors, with the dorkos server spread LAST so it always wins. Only wire under the existing claude-code guard. Tests with FakeAgentRuntime + a manifest with one enabled + one disabled server: factory output includes only the enabled server and dorkos unshadowed; a reserved-name collision cannot displace dorkos.
tasks.acceptance: Enabled managed servers reach the SDK options inline; disabled ones do not; dorkos never shadowed; tests green.

tasks.subject: [mcp-server-management] [P3] Transport methods for MCP server management
tasks.description: Add MCP management methods to the Transport interface (packages/shared/src/transport.ts) and both implementations (HttpTransport, DirectTransport): list/add/update/remove/enable/disable/test, mapped to the §7 routes. Destructive verbs surface the capability ApprovalRequiredPayload to the caller. No raw fetch in the client. Unit-test the Http mapping.
tasks.acceptance: Transport methods present in interface + both impls; client never calls fetch directly.
